comments.text: Unfortunately student loans are only beneficial to people in public service positions(city, county, state, and federal agencies). The way the law is written it makes it impossible to pay them off. The payment is based off the students discretionary income not the loan amount. So if you borrow $25k with 6% interest your payment should be about $150-200 month for the 20 years. But if your discretionary income is low, times 10% your student loan payment likely will not cover the interest for most people. That interest goes back into the loan. 😢if you have 2 or 3 loans, and the one payment split among them it impossible. Eventually the loan becomes a mortgage. At least public service workers can have their loans discharged after 10yrs.
